source.title: DORA - Frequently Asked Questions | Central Bank of Ireland
source.applicability: National implementation guidance showing proportionality application (e.g., reduced incident reporting scope for smaller entities), management body resource allocation examples, and simplified framework eligibility criteria based on entity size/criticality.

passages.text: A simplified RMF is provided for certain types of FEs
Some specific requirements do not apply for microenterprises

The rules relating to the ICT Risk Management Framework (RMF) are required to be implemented proportionally, taking into account their size and overall risk profile and the nature, scale, and complexity of their activities and operations
